title: Employment vs Deployment
text: [Music] there's a difference between being employed and being deployed let me read this it says your job is what you were trained to do but your work is what you were born to do your job is your career your work is your life's assignment your job is your skill your work is your gift you can be fired from your job you can never be fired from your work you can retire from your job you can never retire from your work jobs that temporary work is permanent so if you lost your job today the good news is you haven't lost your work I was talking to a lady who came to me in my office and she said pastor miles and lost my job I've been at my job for 23 years and they actually laid me off because of the crisis and she was crying and I said what are you crying for I said wipe your tears she said why I said I said do you have a house she said yes I'm paying rent I said you have a car she said yes I'm paying a note is there an oven in your house she said yes how many times do you use it she said once a week every Sunday I used my oven I said your problem is you don't have a lack of a job you have a lack of thinking I said why don't you go home take your oven get some flowers and water and some oats make some cookies and turn your oven into a production Center make cookies I said and first of all when you make them go back to the place you were working and all your family give them the cookies free first why cuz you always plant a seed first I said and then when they want more you simply make more in six months this woman ended up with a cookie business a year later she is now providing not only job 420 people she has a cookie factory she had to buy the commercial ovens she now have a cookie business and she is now worth over million dollars she lost the job and never lost her work her gift was actually cooking baking cookies and it took losing a job to become a millionaire
